records.observation: Abstract paint/toString contract with seven public static final singleton references constructed in static initializer. parseString compares input equalsIgnoreCase against ColorXOR,ColorRaised,ColorLowered,WhiteRaised,WhiteLowered,WhitePlain,Empty in that order; returns shared singleton, unknown returns null. No trim or null guard: null input throws. Combined with already-read State.setBorderStyle accepting null, callers must handle parse failure before paint; no caller enforcement inferred. Default State border references WHITE_RAISED_BORDER. Constructor Object only.

records.scope: Entire javap output displayed for all eight StateBorder family classes; no archived execution or raster validation.
records.observation: Constructor calls superclass only. paint receives x1,y1,left-valid,x2,y2,right-valid. Inclusive width=x2-x1+1 and height=y2-y1+1 use unchecked int arithmetic. Paint order bottom, optional right, top, optional left with one-pixel fillRect strips; top/bottom always attempted, vertical sides only when corresponding flag true. No coordinate sorting, positivity/clipping validation or saved color/graphics state. Corners can be painted multiple times; tiny/inverted rectangles not handled separately. Bottom/right use supplied color.brighter(); top/left use supplied color.darker(), which remains graphics color on return. toString ColorLowered. Supplied color dereferenced without null guard.
